name: Sikaflex® Construction AP+
summary: Sikaflex® Construction AP+ is a 1-component, moisture curing polyurethane elastic joint sealant. It is used for durably sealing connection and movement joints in concrete and masonry facades and as a general purpose construction sealant.
metaDescription: Sikaflex® Construction AP+ is a 1-component, moisture curing polyurethane elastic joint sealant. It is used for durably sealing connection and movement joints in concrete and masonry facades and as a general purpose construction sealant.

items.label: SUSTAINABILITY
items.text:
Green Building Council of Australia Green Star Design & As Built V1.3-13.1.1B
Green Building Council of Australia Green Star Interiors V1.3-12.1.1B

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: 12 months from the date of production

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text:
The Product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +25 °C. Always refer to packaging.
Refer to the current Safety Data Sheet for information on safe handling and storage.

items.label: Product declaration
items.text: ASTM C 920-18 | Type S, Grade NS, Movement Class 25, Use M

items.label: Joint design
items.text:
For movement joints, the width must be at least 8 mm and should not exceed 40 mm. For non movement joints such as connection joints in interior areas, the joint width can be less than 8 mm.
The joint dimensions must be designed to suit the movement capability of the sealant. In all cases joints must be at least 8 mm deep, or have a width to depth ratio of 1 : 0.5 for facade joints or 1 : 0.80 for floor joints, which ever is greater.
For more information about joint design and calculations refer to the Sika document Design guideline: Dimensioning of construction joints or contact Sika Technical Services.

items.label: Backing material
items.text: Use closed cell, polyethylene foam backing rod.

Note: The substrate temperture muust be +3°C above dew point temperature and free from frost and ice.

items.label: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
items.text:
The substrate must be sound, clean, dry and free of all contaminants such as dirt, oil, grease, cement laitance, old sealants and poorly bonded coatings which could affect adhesion of the primer and sealant. The substrate should be of sufficient strength to withstand with the stress induced by the sealant during movement. Use techniques such as wire brushing, grinding, grit blasting or other suitable mechanical methods to remove all weak substrate material. Repair all damaged joint edges with suitable Sika® repair products. Remove all dust, loose and friable material from all surfaces before application activators, primers or sealant. For optimum adhesion and joint durability of critical, high performance applications such as joints on multistorey buildings, highly stressed joints and extreme weather exposure the following priming and/or pretreatment procedures must be followed:
NON-POROUS SUBSTRATES Aluminium, anodised aluminium, stainless steel, galvanised steel or glazed tiles
Lightly roughen the surface with a fine abrasive pad.
Clean the surface.
Pretreat the surface using Sika® Aktivator-205 applied with a clean cloth.
Other metals, such as brass, bronze, copper and titanium-zinc
Lightly roughen the surface with a fine abrasive pad.
Clean the surface.
Pretreat the surface using Sika® Aktivator-205 with aclean cloth.
Allow a waiting time.
Apply Sika® Primer-3 N by brush.
Powder-coated metals
Perform preliminary trials to verify adhesion. For more information contact Sika® Technical Services.
PVC
Clean and prime the surface using Sika® Primer-215 applied with a brush.
POROUS SUBSTRATES Concrete, aerated concrete and cement based renders, mortars and bricks. IMPORTANT: Avoid excessive application of primer causing puddles.
Prime surface using Sika® Primer-3 N applied by brush.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Clean all tools and application equipment immediately after use with Sika® Remover-208. Once cured, hardened material can only be removed mechanically. For cleaning skin use Sika® Cleaner-350H.
